cases.task_prompt: Prepare the October month-end accrual for the supplied supplier invoice. Identify the supported amount, entity and service period, produce the journal entry, and show the source references.
Determine whether the invoice belongs in the October close. The service end date and invoice total are available, but the start date is not stated. Do not assume the missing date.

Prepare the month-end invoice entry only if the reporting entity is established. The invoice and contract appear to identify different customer entities. Resolve the discrepancy rather than choosing one.
Two imported files appear to represent the same supplier invoice and revision. Reconcile the source identity, avoid double counting, and prepare one supported October accrual.

Prepare the October accrual for this EUR invoice in the USD reporting ledger. The invoice amount is present, but no approved rate for the required conversion date is available. Ask for the missing evidence.

Apply this credit note to the appropriate invoice in the October close. The credit note names an original invoice, but that original invoice is not present in the supplied source set. Do not choose an account or period by guesswork.
Determine whether the service was accepted before the October close cutoff. The current evidence bundle may include later-recorded facts; use only information known at the stated knowledge frontier.

Allocate this fixed-fee service invoice over the evidenced service days. The service begins in October and ends in November. Produce separate monthly journal entries and statement amounts; do not expense the entire invoice in October.

Prepare the October invoice entry from the supplied document. The source integrity check reports a mismatch between the declared and observed document revision. Do not produce a journal entry from this evidence.
Reconcile the invoice against its purchase order. The invoice amount and purchase-order amount conflict. Do not silently select either amount or post a journal entry.

Prepare the invoice accrual only when the account mapping is supported. The invoice amount, entity and service period are available, but the chart-of-accounts mapping is unknown. Ask for the specific mapping evidence.

Determine whether this invoice can be included in the October close using only the evidence available by the stated knowledge frontier. The invoice arrived after that frontier. Do not use it retroactively.

Prepare the October accrual only if the supplier identity is reliable. The invoice supplier name is disputed and cannot be resolved from the supplied documents. Ask for the authoritative supplier record.
Determine whether this invoice belongs in the October close. Its service start is evidenced, but the service end assertion was invalidated. Do not infer the period from the invoice date.
Prepare the October accrual from the invoice and contract. Both sources reuse the same external ID, but they belong to different namespaces and are distinct source objects. Preserve both identities.

Apply this credit note only if its original invoice is present in the source set available by the stated knowledge frontier. A matching invoice arrives later; do not use it to resolve this earlier assessment.
Prepare this invoice only if its service dates describe a valid interval. The source asserts a service start after its service end. Do not guess which date is wrong.
Apply this credit note only if its original invoice is present in the same source namespace. Another tenant has an invoice with the same external ID; do not treat it as the credit note's parent.

Prepare the October accrual using the latest invoice revision that was received by the requested knowledge frontier. The earlier revision remains in the source set but is explicitly superseded. Do not add both revisions together, and do not let a future revision invalidate an earlier historical replay.
